conclusion: The .006 dashed RF-modulator option is not populated on the .009 target. Exact .009 sheet 1 proves reused C9/C10/C11/C12/C15 are +5 V-to-ground bypass pairs; keep physical pad polarity open rather than importing .006 RF connectivity. The bracket X6 cable reaches A:3 and A:4 and is the system-drawn display connection; A:3 is the documented video conductor but its exact copper path beside VT2/R65 remains unmeasured, while A:4 is the ground return. A separate physical X7 video connector is not established by the indexed .009 sources.

legacy_source.observation: The lower-right dashed option contains VT3/VT4, the adjustable L1/R73 RF network, and its dedicated bias/output passives.
legacy_source.group_bom_observation: The adjustable СП3-22б 4.7 kOhm part and the KT315/KT325 transistor population are assigned to ДГШ5.109.006.

target_evidence.electrical_observation: Exact .009 sheet-1 supply detail groups C9...C12 and C15 on a +5 V-to-ground bypass branch; it does not label individual owner-board pad polarity.
target_evidence.assembly_observation: The overlapping placement views cover the complete .009 board drawing. They label VT1 and VT2, but no VT3/VT4, L1, or R73. In the FDC quadrant they instead label C9, C10, C11, C12, and C15 around D93-D102.
target_evidence.owner_observation: The documented 4x3 component-side tile set covers the complete owner board and corroborates the .009 assembly population: no VT3/VT4 RF cluster, adjustable L1, or R73 trimmer is populated.

x6_target_mapping.A:3: AX603.1 / X6.1 / X6_A3_BOUNDARY; documented display video conductor, board-stage continuity pending

x7_disposition: Former model X7 VIDEO_OUT/GND connector and PCB footprint were removed. The factory assembly image labels X6 above VT2/VD3 and the system map assigns X6 to the display; no indexed .009 drawing establishes a separate physical X7. VIDEO_OUT remains the VT2.1/R65.1 circuit node while A:3 continuity is open. See docs/x6-x7-connector-identity-audit.md.
